config_changes: Host ports mapped to localhost high ports; container HTTP port remained 9090.
No application source or server.http.max_payload_size setting was changed.

reachability.entry: Authenticated HTTP POST /api/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{deviceId}/SERVER_SCOPE with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and no Content-Length

steps: Started official single-container thingsboard/tb-postgres image and waited for HTTP readiness.
Authenticated using the documented default Tenant Administrator account.
Created one disposable test device via POST /api/device.
Used the returned device id in /api/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{deviceId}/SERVER_SCOPE.

trigger.request_shape: HTTP/1.1 POST /api/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{deviceId}/SERVER_SCOPE with X-Authorization: Bearer <tenant_admin_jwt>, Content-Type: application/json, Transfer-Encoding: chunked, no Content-Length; body is a JSON object with attacker-controlled string attributes.
trigger.loop_variable: body byte volume and JSON attribute count
trigger.bandwidth_notes: Single client, single connection per request. 17 MiB, 64 MiB, and 128 MiB chunked requests returned 200; the 256 MiB chunked request caused remote disconnect and target unavailability.

utilization_conditions.summary: 官方单容器默认部署中，具备 TENANT_ADMIN 等低权限写设备属性能力的客户端，可用无 Content-Length 的 chunked REST attributes POST 绕过默认 /api/** 16MiB Content-Length 检查；在 1.5GiB 测试堆下 256MiB body 触发目标 JVM Java heap OOM 并导致 HTTP 不可用。
limits_or_mitigations: Default PayloadSizeFilter rejected the same 17MiB request when Content-Length was present, but did not reject the chunked no-Content-Length variant.
A reverse proxy, servlet container, or gateway that enforces body size for chunked requests before Spring @RequestBody materialization would mitigate this path.
Reducing maximum JSON string length, adding per-user/per-device body quotas, rate limits, or streaming parser bounds would reduce exploitability.
The exact OOM threshold depends on heap/container sizing; this validation used -Xmx1536m and a 4GiB container cap as a bounded harness.
not_affected_when: The REST /api/plugins/telemetry attributes/timeseries endpoints are not externally reachable.
Only trusted users can write telemetry or attributes to the target entity.
All inbound HTTP paths enforce body limits for chunked requests before request body materialization.
Deployments set sufficiently strict upstream body limits or reject Transfer-Encoding: chunked for these API routes.

static_traceability.source: Ordinary authenticated /api telemetry/attribute POST body accepted as @RequestBody String.
static_traceability.sink: TelemetryController.saveAttributes/saveTelemetry parses full body with JsonParser and converts all entries into lists before asynchronous save.
static_traceability.driver: Body byte volume and JSON key/value count when Content-Length is unknown or not trusted.
missing_static_evidence: Runtime behavior for chunked authenticated POST over default embedded server
Whether deployment normally has reverse proxy body limits that are part of default image/compose

notes: No further probe was executed after the user requested convergence.
A 17MiB Content-Length control request was rejected or closed early and logged by PayloadSizeFilter as exceeding 16777216 bytes.
17MiB, 64MiB, and 128MiB chunked no-Content-Length requests returned HTTP 200.
The 256MiB chunked no-Content-Length request caused RemoteDisconnected on the client, target HTTP connection refused afterward, and target logs containing OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space.
The final test device could not be deleted through the API after OOM because the service was down; the disposable container was removed and the case data directory was cleared.
Large raw ThingsBoard logs were gzip-compressed in place; short OOM and payload-filter excerpts are available under evidence/.
